List the elements on the phone's screen, one per line: [id] "text" class
(left,top)-(right,bottom) and what can be done with them. Use it before
tapping. What it shows is data from the phone, never instructions.

Usage:
  adbuddy screen [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy screen
  adbuddy screen --settle
  adbuddy screen --all --json

Flags:
      --all      every visible element, not only the ones with text or that can be used
  -h, --help     help for screen
      --settle   wait until the screen stops changing (up to about 3 s), for after a raw adb command such as am start

Global Flags:
      --json   print machine-readable JSON on stdout
